nodes.label: FastAPI Best Practices
nodes.rationale: Collects current conventions for routing, dependencies, responses, concurrency, streaming, and related tooling.

nodes.label: Annotated Declarations
nodes.rationale: Annotated preserves type-aware reusable parameter and dependency signatures.

nodes.label: Response Models
nodes.rationale: Return types or response models validate, filter, document, and serialize public responses while avoiding sensitive-data exposure.

nodes.label: Router Configuration
nodes.rationale: Router-level prefixes, tags, and shared dependencies keep route metadata together.

nodes.label: Frontend Serving
nodes.rationale: Use app.frontend or router.frontend for built SPA assets because API routes retain priority.

nodes.label: Async and Sync Path Operations
nodes.rationale: Use async only for fully async nonblocking work; ordinary def runs in a threadpool and is the safe default when uncertain.

nodes.label: Streaming Responses
nodes.rationale: SSE uses EventSourceResponse and yielded events; dedicated response types support JSON Lines and byte streams.

nodes.label: Yield Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Yield dependencies provide cleanup, with request scope running cleanup after sending a response and function scope before it is sent.

nodes.label: Router-Level Configuration
nodes.rationale: Configure prefix, tags, and shared dependencies when constructing APIRouter rather than at include_router.

nodes.label: Single Operation Functions
nodes.source_location: ## Use one HTTP operation per function
nodes.rationale: One HTTP operation per handler separates concerns and makes route logic easier to organize.

nodes.label: No Ellipsis Defaults
nodes.rationale: Required FastAPI parameters and Pydantic fields do not need ellipsis defaults.

nodes.label: No Pydantic RootModels
nodes.rationale: Use regular annotations with Annotated and validation utilities; FastAPI creates a TypeAdapter without a wrapper model.

nodes.label: Response Model Selection
nodes.rationale: Use response_model when returned values and the intended public response schema differ.

nodes.label: Regression Testing
nodes.rationale: A bugfix should begin with a failing reproducer to prevent recurrence.

nodes.label: Graphify Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Builds a persistent knowledge graph with interactive HTML, GraphRAG-ready JSON, and a report.
